doctor_tenma.name: Doctor Tenma
doctor_tenma.win_condition: Help the town win. (Wins with Town)
doctor_tenma.description: A brilliant neurosurgeon who believes all lives are equal.
doctor_tenma.active_ability: Hand of Compassion (Heal/protect a player, cannot target same player consecutively). Max Ability: Scalpel of Justice (Revive a dead mafia member as a Default Villager after successfully saving at least 3 players).

ayanokoji_kiyotaka.name: Ayanokoji Kiyotaka
ayanokoji_kiyotaka.win_condition: Help the town win. (Wins with Town)
ayanokoji_kiyotaka.description: An elite student who manipulates situations from the shadows.
ayanokoji_kiyotaka.active_ability: Shadow Analysis (Investigate a player's true faction; result is immune to framing/diversion). Max Ability: Final Stand (From Night 9 onwards, passive check reveals the identity of an active mafia player).

l.name: L
l.win_condition: Help the town win. (Wins with Town)
l.description: The world's greatest detective seeking to bring justice.
l.active_ability: Justice's Eye (Investigate a player. 1st scan: Faction. 2nd scan on same player: Role. 3rd scan on same player: Target history, charges, and Max Ability status).

blackbeard.name: Blackbeard
blackbeard.win_condition: Eliminate all threats to the Mafia. (Wins with Mafia)
blackbeard.description: A ruthless pirate captain wielding the power of darkness.
blackbeard.active_ability: Darkness Logia (Roleblock a player, 1 night cooldown). Max Ability: Tremor Fruit (Earthquake roleblocks all Town and Neutral players for one night).

light_yagami.name: Light Yagami
light_yagami.win_condition: Eliminate all threats to the Mafia. (Wins with Mafia)
light_yagami.description: A brilliant student with a notebook of death and a god complex.
light_yagami.active_ability: Death Note (Guess a player's role; if correct, they are eliminated). Max Ability: The Devil's Pen (Write a player's name; they die unpreventably after 3 nights, 3 night cooldown).
light_yagami.action_prompt: Select a player to target in your Death Note:

muzan_kibutsuji.name: Muzan Kibutsuji
muzan_kibutsuji.win_condition: Eliminate all threats to the Mafia. (Wins with Mafia)
muzan_kibutsuji.description: The original demon progenitor seeking blue spider lily.
muzan_kibutsuji.active_ability: Blood Demon Art (Every 3rd night, starting Night 3, transform a Town player into a Demon: 85% basic demon, 10% Lower Moon roleblocker, 5% Upper Moon killer).
muzan_kibutsuji.passive_ability: Instant Regeneration (Survive first attack; healed targets give extra charge).
muzan_kibutsuji.action_prompt: Select a town member to infect:

makima.name: Makima
makima.win_condition: Eliminate all threats to the Mafia. (Wins with Mafia)
makima.description: The Control Devil who manipulates others' wills.
makima.active_ability: Control Order (Every 2nd night, force a player to vote for another target on the next day, 2 uses). Max Ability: Devil's Vendetta (If about to die, redirect death to a random neutral).
makima.action_prompt: Select the player you wish to control:

orochimaru.name: Orochimaru
orochimaru.win_condition: Eliminate all threats to the Mafia. (Wins with Mafia)
orochimaru.description: A legendary Sannin obsessed with immortality and forbidden jutsu.
orochimaru.active_ability: Reanimation Jutsu (Revive a dead player and use their active ability randomly for the night). Max Ability: Forbidden Rebirth (Self-revive once at the end of the day if lynched/killed).
orochimaru.action_prompt: Select a dead player to reanimate:

hisoka.name: Hisoka Morow
hisoka.win_condition: WinCondition 1: Get voted out before Night 5 (revive for 3 days with roleblock, steal, and kill abilities). WinCondition 2: Correctly predict two players visiting one another 3 times using Bungee Gum.
hisoka.description: A whimsical magician searching for strong opponents.
hisoka.active_ability: Bungee Gum (Link two players. If one visits the other, gain 1 point. Need 3 points).
hisoka.passive_ability: Post-Mortem Nen (Revive if voted out early).
hisoka.action_prompt: Select the first player to link with Bungee Gum:

gilgamesh.name: Gilgamesh
gilgamesh.win_condition: Find all of your swords (3 or 5 depending on lobby size) to become the Horseman of Apocalypse, then survive for 1 day to trigger the Rumbling apocalypse.
gilgamesh.description: The King of Heroes who holds all the world's treasures.
gilgamesh.active_ability: Gate of Babylon (Visit a player to search for your sword. If found, you retrieve it).
gilgamesh.passive_ability: Apocalypse (Transform once all swords are collected; unleashes wipeout next night if not lynched).
gilgamesh.action_prompt: Select a player to search for your sword:

lelouch_lamperouge.name: Lelouch Lamperouge
lelouch_lamperouge.win_condition: Geass guess: Declare you will be voted out. If lynched that day, you win. Guessing wrong 3 times kills you. Cannot declare on consecutive days.
lelouch_lamperouge.description: The exiled prince who commands others under the guise of Zero.
lelouch_lamperouge.active_ability: Absolute Command (Declare you will be lynched today).

eren_jaeger.name: Eren Jaeger
eren_jaeger.win_condition: Survive until Night 8 to trigger The Rumbling, then kill everyone until you are the last one standing.
eren_jaeger.description: A boy who sought freedom, now the Founding Titan.
eren_jaeger.active_ability: Founding Vision (Learn player faction). Max Ability: The Rumbling (From Night 9 onwards, gain un-lynchable status and kill a player every day).
eren_jaeger.action_prompt: Select a player to look at or attack:

mahoraga.name: Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga
mahoraga.win_condition: Survive an attack and eliminate at least 1 player who tried to kill you.
mahoraga.passive_ability: Adaptation (75% chance to survive attacks. Upon surviving, gain permanent immunity to the attacker's role and lynch immunity for 1 day).

villager.name: Default Villager
villager.win_condition: Help the town win. (Wins with Town)
villager.description: A normal citizen of the anime town.

default_villain.name: Default Villain
default_villain.win_condition: Eliminate all threats to the Mafia. (Wins with Mafia)
default_villain.description: A standard antagonist who works from the shadows.
default_villain.active_ability: Assassinate (Select a target to eliminate every night).

demon.name: Demon
demon.win_condition: Eliminate all threats to the Mafia. (Wins with Mafia)
demon.description: A human turned demon by Muzan Kibutsuji.

lower_moon.name: Lower Moon Demon
lower_moon.win_condition: Eliminate all threats to the Mafia. (Wins with Mafia)
lower_moon.description: A powerful demon who serves Muzan Kibutsuji.

upper_moon.name: Upper Moon Demon
upper_moon.win_condition: Eliminate all threats to the Mafia. (Wins with Mafia)
upper_moon.description: A lethal demon with supreme power.
